dCKB.summary: dCKB scripts validated the transaction as a whole, so one fresh deposit with a receipt unlocked many deposits. 201 deposits were drained; the remaining 196 deposits were claimed on 2026-10-18 and cashed out. dCKB is unbacked.

RGB++.summary: Per the ckb-adversary proposal, 16.59M CKB was taken from RGB++ cells with 1,464 forged Bitcoin proofs and went unnoticed for 80 days. A verification result was checked for an error but not for validity.

iCKB.summary: Anyone can create fake limit orders; an owner can be tricked into melting the wrong one, stranding funds. The iCKB stack mitigates client-side by rejecting orders that differ from the original mint order.
